mapper.select: WITH d AS ( SELECT (CURRENT_DATE - (n || ' days')::interval)::date AS day FROM generate_series(#{days}::integer - 1, 0, -1) AS n ) SELECT TO_CHAR(d.day, 'MM-DD') AS label, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_user u WHERE u.reg_dt::date = d.day) AS signups, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_bbs b WHERE b.reg_dt::date = d.day AND b.use_yn = 'Y' AND b.p_bbs_id = 0) AS posts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_recruit r WHERE r.reg_dt::date = d.day AND r.use_yn = 'Y') AS recruits FROM d ORDER BY d.day

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_user WHERE use_yn = 'Y') AS "userCnt", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_user WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND status_cd = 'STATUS03') AS "suspendedCnt", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_bbs WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND p_bbs_id = 0) AS "postCnt", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_comment WHERE use_yn = 'Y') AS "commentCnt", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_recruit WHERE use_yn = 'Y') AS "recruitCnt", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_recruit WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND status_cd = 'RECRUIT01') AS "recruitOpenCnt", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_hobby WHERE use_yn = 'Y') AS "hobbyCnt", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_report WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND status = 'PENDING') AS "reportPendingCnt"
